messages.author: 9407d03fb6deb543
messages.subject: permission denied after R3.01 installed
parts:
Hi

I upgraded to shiny 0.6 and use shiny-server. It was working perfectly on a linux machine until I upgrade to R3.01.
Now I have this type of message.
Any ideas

Warning in file(filename, "r", encoding = encoding) :
  cannot open file '/var/shiny-server/www/folder0/folder01/server.R': Permission denied
Error in file(filename, "r", encoding = encoding) :
  cannot open the connection Calls:
runApp ... eval.parent -> eval -> eval -> eval -> eval -> source -> file
Execution halted

I did a appropriate chmod and chown

?? Any ideas

Many Thanks

messages.author: 05f098102a2ea7f2
messages.subject: Re: permission denied after R3.01 installed
parts: I've seen this message when the file was not present, but if you've confirmed the file is there I would check folder/file permissions. Are you familiar with chmod? Type "man chmod" in the terminal.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: permission denied after R3.01 installed
parts:
Can you try this (assuming that the run_as directive in your shiny-server.conf is set to "shiny":

sudo su - shiny -c "cat /var/shiny-server/www/folder0/folder01/server.R"

If that doesn't work, then it's still a chmod/chown problem. Make sure that each of the containing folders is readable and executable by shiny. (Doesn't generally need to be writable, just r-x is fine.)

Again thanks for your time and support
I tried your suggestion below and it didnt fix the problem.

I found apparently a "solution" as I disabled RAppArmor on ubuntu ...aa-disable usr.bin.r and the permission message disappeared. So  it seems to be related to RAppArmor not working after R3.01 upgrade. I have to investigate more.
I apologize for the trouble but was a little bit desperate after spending some hours with the issue.
